title: Week 1 Power Rankings
subtitle: Multi-factor board: HQ custom projections (Fantrax base + injury/trade adjusts), Week 1 matchup edges, 0–0 records. Rest-of-season SOS fills once the full Fantrax schedule is in.
method: composite = 50% HQ custom W1 + 35% matchup edge + 15% Fantrax W1. Corrections: Nix→FAAB (not Love); Towner (Slumlords) vs Chase (TTAB).

rankings.blurb: Widest projected cushion of the week at the Goats. 0–0 like everyone else, but this is the softest landing — cash it and stay loud while SOS is still a mystery past W1.
